intent: identity-preserving sprite atlas generation from local references

player.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling action game sprite atlas, transparent background.
Primary request: a precise regular 4 columns by 4 rows sprite atlas with exactly 16 separate full-body poses of the SAME male swordsman. Use reference image 1 as the character identity, costume, rendering and palette reference only. Maintain consistent anatomy, head shape, age and costume across every cell.
Subject: handsome young adult male with spiky silver-white hair and one red streak, black long leather trench coat with deep red lining, red bandages on left arm, black boots, ONE long black-handled steel sword. No flames around arm.
Style: premium hand-drawn 2D Korean action RPG, crisp expressive silhouette, clean dark linework, high fidelity cel shading and restrained painterly highlights. Side view with subtle three-quarter torso, ALWAYS facing RIGHT.
Layout: 2048x2048 square, exact evenly spaced 4x4 grid, each cell 512x512. No visible grid, no labels, no text, no border. Within every cell full character AND full blade remain inside cell with generous 32 pixel gap to cell edges. Same unscaled physical character proportions in all 16 cells. Feet at the same local floor baseline near 450 pixels; character standing body about 360 pixels tall; body root centered near local x=240. Sword may extend horizontally but never leave its cell. Actual transparent alpha; no ground, no shadow, no texture background.
Cells row-major:
ROW 1 / ready and defense: (1) combat idle sword lowered diagonally forward; (2) slightly compressed idle breathing with coat moving; (3) guard with sword diagonally shielding face and chest; (4) low crouch preparing leap with both knees bent sword held behind.
ROW 2 / four consecutive running cycle phases facing right: (5) left leg extended forward right leg back, leaning forward coat trailing left; (6) legs passing under hips; (7) right leg extended forward left leg back; (8) second legs passing, coat lifted differently. Each cell is a physically distinct genuine stride pose.
ROW 3 / four clearly distinct sword attack keyframes: (9) windup torso coiled, sword back at left waist; (10) forceful horizontal slash sword extended straight RIGHT, low stance; (11) rising uppercut sword upward-right with torso extending; (12) overhead heavy slash follow-through sword down-right, coat flaring left. Exactly one sword each, NO painted slash effect.
ROW 4 / reaction and recovery: (13) airborne knees slightly tucked facing right sword behind; (14) recoil from a blow from the right, upper torso leaning left, bent knees; (15) knocked down on back along floor, head to left boots to right and blade along floor, still entirely within cell; (16) rising from one knee, facing right, sword planted angled forward.
Constraints: all sixteen are the SAME character in varied real poses, do not repeat the standing illustration. Preserve reference costume and black/red palette. No extra limbs, no duplicate weapons, no decorative particles, no UI, no typography. Clearly separate cells using transparent empty gutters.

monster.prompt:

Layout: square image with exact equally sized 4x4 grid. No visible grid, no labels or text, no border. Each cell contains full goblin AND club completely, with 10 percent empty margin to every edge. Transparent alpha, no ground shadow, no checkerboard texture.

ROW 1 / combat ready: (1) ready hunched stance facing right club angled up-right; (2) same idle with knees flexed and chest shifting; (3) alert guarded stance club held close to chest; (4) aggressive crouch leaning forward grinning.
ROW 2 / four genuine consecutive running gait phases facing right: (5) left foot forward right back, club behind; (6) knees passing under hip and body lifted; (7) right foot forward left back; (8) second knee passing with body lowered. All four leg and arm silhouettes must differ.
